title: The hidden base

members.role: ONE stacked bar in true proportion - the hidden part at the base under a `water` rule at its top, the visible part above it - every figure written, the page opening with the camera raised on the tip
as the voice goes into the filings ('there's another eight hundred', the first word after the page's build has settled - M14), the camera drops once through the water to the base, then holds
on the words that name what is hidden, the light falls on the hidden part only - never the whole bar

does: The tip stands over a waterline with the base below the frame; the camera drops through the water to the hidden base in true proportion, and the light falls on the hidden part.

use_when.act: DIVIDES - the hidden part is bigger than the visible part (BRAVOS-USE-WHEN R1 / T1)
use_when.shape: parts of a whole: two stocks of one unit, one on the books and one off, both sourced
use_when.use: the tip, the waterline, the base under the water, the light on the hidden part, every figure written (H row 16: $261B of bonds over $822B of lease commitments, ev-leases-iceberg-v1)
use_when.dont: draw it without its figures written (s100 (b)); light the whole bar; move the camera over the page's build (M14); type a total - derive it into a committed object

source: P72 T53 (a) (R26-412 (a); harvest R1 / T1 / A33, BUB 0:00-0:48; P71 T34's stopped recipe); proved as a private test-bed beat by projects/_proofs/p72-t53/proof_t53.py on Steel and Paper H row 16 ('And that's the borrowing you can see ... never landed on a balance sheet') on the committed ev-leases-iceberg-v1 (derive_iceberg.py) - no approved cut carries it
